notes.title: Working on a new game ~ Captain Clive: Danger From Dione
notes.content:
[h1]What is this game?[/h1]
Captain Clive: Danger From Dione is not a direct sequel to The Pillage, but instead is a personal sequel. It's been nearly two years since the release of The Pillage and I wanted to make something new. 

In CC:DFD, you play as Captain Clive, or one of his crew members. You land your small ship in Ophacland, a residential colony of Dione, moon of Saturn. Upon exiting the ship you find that there are no humans left in the colony and that aliens have overthrown the area.

Your goal is to mow down hordes of aliens while staying alive. As you play through the waves, the game continues to get more difficult. To deal with this difficulty, you must balance your resources while making strategic decisions through combat and spending.

[h1]Is this game for me?[/h1]
Do you like first person shooters? Do you like third person shooters? This game has both.
Do you like endless waves of enemies? This game has it. Right now there are around 50 different enemies.
Do you like big guns? Yes, me too.
Do you like lots of guns? Yes, as do I.
Explosions? yes.
Killing civilians for kidneys? This game is fun, but The Pillage might suit you better.

[h1]When will this game be released?[/h1]
There is no exact date at the moment, but I do not plan for release until I feel this game is ready - hopefully in the 6-8 months range.

[h1]What's to come for The Pillage?[/h1]
I hope to continue to release updates and patches for The Pillage in the future, but as of right now, Captain Clive: Danger From Dione is taking most of my time and resources.

[h1]Screenshots?[/h1]
Here's a few screenshots of the game. These may not fully reflect what the game will look like when it is released because I'm constantly changing things, but pictures are cool.

notes.title: The Pillage Update: Angelic Intervention
notes.content:
[h1]Base game[/h1]
[list]
[*] added a new enemy: the principality. This enemy is a human-sized naked angel which is spawned in the angelic intervention event. They are much faster than the player but have one heart.

notes.title: The Pillage Halloween Update - A Major Overhaul
notes.content:
[H1]Among many other updates to the game, bonus (limited time) spooky content is available in game at the modest cost of zero kidneys![/h1]
The halloween theme changes the look of the whole world! When enabled, no longer is the world the iconic red of the pillage, but dark and orange! All of the civilians will be celebrating spooky season with all black attire this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30666490/15f1872b0dfd347ebe5be6d93307f7b1779c5d90.png[/img]

[h1]BASE GAME[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30666490/3d7c4b765b9206c1c343432fe00e72c019573c11.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a whole load of detail to the world graphics. There is now more shading, noise, and other little differences and variants of textures.
[*] The world now supports true lighting. This means real dynamic lights and shadows now characterize the world.
[*] With the new lighting, street lights have been added to arcade mode. Torches light up the wave mode area.
[*] Added two new weapons - the keysword and the executioner.
[*] Added game themes which change the look of the world and the ai.
[*] Updated the UI again.
[*] The player jumps higher and vertical hitbox size reduced.
[*] Wave mode now has it's own setting.
[*] Added the parallax effect back, but this time it's good.
[*] Added bonus achievements to give the player more goals.
[/list]
[h1]AI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30666490/2ca7df8049b779f6c9f5da3d6953417cfee0240a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy: the archangel. This enemy has 6  hearts and will spawn after god's wrath has ensued enough times in a round.
[*] Angels are now faster.
[*] Enemy health bars are more informative.
[*] Added more diversity to death-blood-explosion animations for ai.
[/list]
[h1]OTHER[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new song by inamic, blood, to the soundtrack.
[*] Hearts now have a new homing system, so there should be less left behind.
[*] Added a bunch of new static buildings.
[*] Added more diversity to the normal buildings.
[*] Made static buildings 25% more common.
[*] Special abilities are now called abilities
[*] Adjusted weapon prices and level unlocks. Additional balances happened on some weapons.
[/list]
[h1]BUGS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed extra xp being added in certain quit conditions.
[*] Fixed the game breaking when players walked too far to one side.
[*] Window size and fullscreen mode now save
[*] Added a lot more
[/list]

notes.title: Valentine's Day Update - Special Abilities, Perks, Weapons, New Police, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for joining me today to celebrate this massive new update for The Pillage - Version 2.0.0![/b]

[u]The World[/u]
[list]
[*] The gamespace now has depth. AI will appear at random depths on the sidewalk. This makes killing crowds feel so much more pleasing.
[*] Removed the parallax effect on buildings. Taking it out all together hugely increased the FPS.
[*] Buildings now have randomized textures to them, making the world feel more fleshed out and immersive
[*] added static occasional static buildings back to the game
[/list]
[u]AI[/u]
[list]
[*] New enemy: shield police. These police spawn as the game progresses. They are currently the only enemy in the game with 4 hearts (3 for the shield, plus 1 for the character).
[*] Angels now have an improved health bar.
[/list]
[u]Weapons[/u]
[list]
[*] Weapons now have specified damage rather than every power attacking dealing 3 damage. This creates more balance and adds for more options in the power attack category.
[*] New fast attack weapons: Sickle, Bonesaw, and Pocketknife. The old Pocketknife was replaced with the Shiv.
[*] New power attack weapons: Pitchfork, Trident, and Scythe.
[*] The Pitchfork and Trident can one-hit shield police.
[*] Weapons are now only available at certain levels to give the game better progression.
[/list]
[u]Special Abilities[/u]
[list]
[*] Added new special abilities, which are unlocked through the achievements like perks.
[*] Four special abilities have been added: Sidekick, Rage, Unkindness, and Vitreous.
[*] When purchased, these can be activated by pressing (S) or (DOWN ARROW).
[/list]
[u]Performance[/u]
[list]
[*] Added the setting to disable blood particles to increase performance.
[/list]
[u]Perks[/u]
[list]
[*] Added the perk 'Out of the Park' which doubles knockback on enemies that don't die in one hit.
[*] Added the perk 'Special' which reduces the time for special abilities to cool down from 30 seconds to 25.
[*] Added a new perks menu.
[/list]
[u]Other[/u]
[list]
[*] New stat tracking that compares total kills to the population of every country in the real world.
[*] Redesigned the user interface to not look so ancient.
[*] Kill counts are far more accurate than before.
[*] An amazing new soundtrack by Inamic.
[*] A load of bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Prepare For a Massive Update
notes.content:
[b]Valentine's Day 2019 is just around the corner, and what better way to celebrate than playing The Pillage![/b]

The new update, among many other things, will include many new weapons, a much more immersive world, significantly less lag, a new enemy, special abilities, and new perks.

Along with this massive update, the game will be moving to a one-time pay-to-play system. As the game has increased in quality, it has such increased in value. With the release of the new update, the game will be moving to $0.99 USD.

I have full intention to hold my promise that this update will be the biggest update and thus the biggest improvement to the game so far. All of the money that is made from this game will be put back into it after the initial overhead has been covered. I hope to continue to provide the community with masses of additional content in the future and moving this game to paid will allow this to happen much quicker and far better.

notes.title: August 14th Update: HarvestSword- The Newest Weapon, New Tutorial, Lots of Random Improvements
notes.content:
The title says a lot, but here's what's changed:

There's a new power swing weapon: The HarvestSword
This weapon is unlocked with "The Third Milestone" achivement. It's biggest strength is in its speed, only slowing you down 40% making it the lightest power swing weapon. It comes in two colors, iron and a brownish bone color.

There's also a new tutorial. To be honest, the old tutorial was easily overlooked and really was just awful, so I made a new. The new tutorial can be accessed by starting a new save game or through the options menu.

Now you can also change the volume before the initial setup/tutorials are over. Really it should have been an option long ago. 

A lot of other little changes were made that make the game overall better, but they really aren't worth noting here.

notes.title: August 11th Update - A much requested feature!
notes.content:
You guys kept asking for it, so I added the option to have secondary attack binded to the right mouse (or R, because there's someone who's playing with the keyboard only controls).

I also adjusted some of the user interface stuff

Also made the Hellhammer's existence more obvoius.

I'm going to be working on more updates soon, and actually posting about the updates now that steam is letting me!
